text: The accepted collector uses lastIndexOf(" ") to fill firstName and lastName for a newly created card or an existing blank displayName. A one-word displayName does not enter that split. This is the current local heuristic, not a complete personal-name parser or a reason to overwrite an existing chosen name. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Address collection splits multiword display names at the last space
